scope: Public HTML only; no Server or Connect source changes, database migrations, customer writes, email sends, model calls or payment operations.

local.browser_limit: Local fixtures, not real provider/customer acceptance or physical-device testing.

rules.description: Norulo exact provider callbacks: skip browser-only checks; retain application authentication
rules.expression: ((http.host eq "norulo.com" and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/auth/github/callback" "/api/integrations/github/callback"}) or (http.host eq "api.norulo.com" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/webhooks/creem"))

rules.description: Norulo website pages: Managed Challenge; APIs, callback paths, assets and verified bots excluded
rules.expression: (http.host in {"norulo.com" "www.norulo.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not cf.client.bot and http.request.uri.path ne "/api" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/openapi/") and not http.request.uri.path in {"/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/favicon.ico" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/brand-mark.png" "/norulo-logo.png" "/social-card.png" "/social-card.svg"})

rules.description: Norulo MCP/OAuth protocol endpoints: skip browser integrity only; retain authentication, WAF and rate limits
rules.expression: (http.host eq "mcp.norulo.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "OPTIONS"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/mcp" "/oauth/register" "/oauth/token" "/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server" "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"})
